read.thesis: Q1 organic sales +23% and adjusted op margin 20.8% (+430bp) on Americas +44% organic; FY26 guide raised to $13.5-14.0bn, but inventory up $378M and deferred revenue up $647M since year-end.

capex.quote: Vertiv is further accelerating capacity expansion and strategic investments to be well positioned to meet this demand and capture market share.

triggers.label: Americas organic sales +44%
triggers.quote: The Americas region led the organic sales growth, expanding 44% on strong data center demand.

triggers.label: FY26 sales guide $13.5-14.0bn
triggers.quote: Expect net sales of $13,500 to $14,000 million, with organic sales growth of 29% to 31% compared to 2025

triggers.label: Adj. op margin 20.8%, +430bp
triggers.quote: Adjusted operating margin was 20.8%, up 430 basis points compared to first quarter 2025, driven by operational leverage on higher volume and positive price-cost

triggers.label: Capex stepped up to $113M
triggers.quote: Vertiv is further accelerating capacity expansion and strategic investments

guidance.quote: Expect net sales of $13,500 to $14,000 million, with organic sales growth of 29% to 31% compared to 2025
Expect full year 2026 diluted EPS of $5.60 to $5.70 and adjusted diluted EPS of $6.30 to $6.40
